test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Compare the following two addresses.

Address 1: Ms. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres, Pune 411045

Address 2: Mrs. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres Society, Pune - 411045

Are these likely to be the same?

options.text: No, city codes do not match
Yes, all details match except name titles
No, the flat numbers are different
No, the name titles are different

solution:
According to the question:

Address 1: **Ms.** Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres, Pune 411045

Address 2: **Mrs.** Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres **Society**, Pune - 411045

Thus, No, the name titles are different.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
